convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load 'FractalAMA_MBK' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trading operations (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose). Custom indicator buffer logic must be manually replicated.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal time tagging
derived_values.used_by: BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen signal time parameter

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA processes signals

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: long crossover triggers SELL_Close, short crossover triggers BUY_Close

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM parameter (0.1) serves as either lot size or fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Crossover detection uses bar[1] vs bar[0] on the indicator buffers: a signal fires when Buffer0[1]>Buffer1[1] (main above signal on previous bar) AND Buffer0[0]<=Buffer1[0] (main was at or below signal on the bar before that). This is a 2-bar crossover confirmation. The SignalBar input (default=1) allows shifting which bar is treated as the current signal bar; when SignalBar==0, the EA evaluates every tick without waiting for a new bar. Signal timestamps are computed as last bar date + TimeShiftSec, passed to the trade functions for possible pending order logic inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup. The Recount flag re-triggers signal evaluation on failed CopyBuffer calls.
python_conversion_notes: The FractalAMA_MBK custom indicator must be ported to Python first - its algorithm (Fractal Adaptive Moving Average with signal line based on multiplier and signal_multiplier) is not available in standard libraries. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all order execution, position sizing across 5 MarginMode variants, and global variable cleanup - this logic must be reimplemented. Entry logic is straightforward: 2-bar crossover of two indicator buffers. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) which likely need digit-adjustment (divide by 10 for 5-digit brokers). The SignalBar parameter acts as a bar shift for signal detection, and the new-bar guard (CIsNewBar) should be replicated to prevent multiple entries per bar.
